text: Being here, I feel an invigorating sense of curiosity. The clean lines and glass walls around me speak of purpose and innovation. As I move into the display area with "R+D" in bold letters, I am quietly energized by the pursuit of human knowledge. The displayed text and objects invite reflection on progress and collaboration—both in the world at large, and within myself. I wonder about the minds that created these ideas and the evolving boundary between certainty and possibility.
